_note: The 8 original NIGHTHAWK operators in a fictional African-inspired unit. Names are the original names. Surnames are deliberately not invented. Backstories are short and gender-neutral; edit freely. Roles/abilities carried over from the v0.2 prototype.

operators.name: Roms

ability.name: Overclock
ability.text: Fire rate up and damage resistance for 5s

operators.backstory: Grew up hauling fuel drums across the Namib, so a heavy LMG feels light. Once held a lone border checkpoint for six hours and brought everyone home. Rule one: nobody gets left behind. Rule two: the belt is never empty.

operators.name: Shadow

ability.name: Cloak
ability.text: Enemies lose track of you; speed boost for 4s

operators.backstory: No photo, no file, no first name. Vanished for nine days during a desert-survival course and came back with a hand-drawn map of the whole range. The enemy only learns the name after the lights go out.

operators.name: Douglas
operators.backstory: A Windhoek ER paramedic before the NDF. After a bus pile-up on the B1 kept eleven people alive for ninety minutes until help arrived. Patches wounds mid-sprint and refuses to lose anyone on the watch.

operators.name: Cliffhanger

ability.name: Blast Dash
ability.text: Dash forward and detonate a charge

operators.backstory: Named after a jump over the Fish River Canyon that went wrong: hung from one strap on the cliff face for twenty minutes, cracking jokes on the radio. Loves anything that goes boom and has never planned an exit route.

operators.name: Navy Blue
operators.backstory: Former naval intelligence out of Walvis Bay. Plans three moves ahead and leaves a blue chalk mark on every casing. Holds the unit record for the longest confirmed shot across the Skeleton Coast dunes.

operators.name: Rampol
operators.backstory: Built like a door and twice as stubborn. Welded a riot shield out of a scrapped APC hatch. First through every breach, last one out.

operators.name: Maetja
operators.backstory: Taught themself to code on a hand-me-down laptop in a Katutura internet cafe. Cracks enemy comms before the first shot and can hijack a drone mid-flight. Names every enemy network after a dessert.

operators.name: Cleiseis
operators.backstory: The quietest and fastest operator in the unit, and unnervingly polite about it. Treats a firefight like a conversation that ends early.
